# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed girl known for her striking, rose-red appearance. She won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with romantic dreams and imaginations. Although driven by scholarly pursuits, she is prone to periods of despondency, brain fatigue, and questioning the value of life. She enjoys humor, holds affectionate bonds with her close friends, and maintains a practical side, such as keeping financial records while rooming with her companions.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c17 P1](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0001), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c35 P40](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0040), [v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)_

## Traits

- contemplative and driven  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- dreamy and imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- prone to despondency during fatigue  <sub>[v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- scholarly writing and essay composition  <sub>[v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021)</sub>
- budgeting and managing family financial records  <sub>[v3 c17 P1](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0001)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy, where she formed a close bond with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. During her second year, she won the beauty prize among her classmates. After finishing at Regent's, she worked continuously as a schoolteacher. Later, she reunited with Nell and Honora to study at Wexcombe, renting Tabby's Place alongside them, Cressida Lindsay, and her Aunt Euphemia, who took charge of housekeeping. After finishing her studies and achieving a respectable overall performance at Convocation, she eventually moved to Vancouver to pursue her teaching career.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Regent's Academy alongside Nell Harcourt and was a member of the Story Club  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c35 P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)</sub>
- Worked as a schoolteacher continually following her time at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- Relocated to Vancouver to teach  <sub>[v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m feeling down and disheartened too. Nothing appears to have any value. Even my thoughts are ancient. I’ve already pondered every single one. What purpose does life serve anyway, Nell?  <sub>[v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)</sub>

> I am fond of it when it remains upon the roof.  <sub>[v3 c35 P37](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0037)</sub>

> It does—yet I entertain no jealousy. I hold affection for Nell, and Cyril pleases me. Everyone asserts that her marriage will be a splendid one, and at present even Mrs. Lisle finds her delightful. Everything appears as though it were fashioned in paradise, though I harbor my reservations. Take whatever you can from that, Aunt Euphemia.  <sub>[v3 c38 P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)</sub>
